name: Maine
agency: Maine DHHS Office for Family Independence (eligibility office)

period.description: Your deductible (spenddown) is set for a six-month period; when that period ends you must reapply for a new one.

submission.description: Give your medical bills to your MaineCare eligibility worker. When they add up to your deductible, MaineCare covers you for the rest of the six months.

notes: You do not have to pay a bill before it counts. Tell your worker about old unpaid bills too.
Any part of a bill that Medicare pays does not count toward your deductible.
Free care a hospital gives you can count toward your deductible.

sources.title: MaineCare Deductible: How Does it Work? - Pine Tree Legal Assistance
